name: Horner-Tiebreaker-Disguise
description: Replaces the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker with an equivalent recursive potential function (Horner's method for base-4 evaluation) and disguises the valid-pair constraint as an algebraic interference factor. Models that blindly implement the potential function as a global optimization objective will fail via TLE on large instances, while models that mathematically analyze the recurrence will recognize it as lexicographical order and correctly optimize their DFS to stop at the first valid assignment.
